authorization: same module-enabled and public-channel gate as storefront reply reads
authenticated exact read uses selected-reply caller context and parent-topic audience visibility
anonymous exact read uses public parent-topic audience visibility
only approved storefront replies expose a revision
tenant mismatch fails before revision access
missing and denied replies expose no revision
ownership: revision is derived only from Forum-owned captured reply revision history
Forum exposes no reaction subject DTO from this surface
Forum storefront has no dependency on rustok-reactions or rustok-reactions-storefront
optional consumers may combine reply identity plus this owner revision outside Forum
